title: Fence Post Repair Bracket 2-Pack – Saves Two Posts Without Digging
descriptionHtml:
2 brackets in the package. One purchase covers two posts – you don't need to add another to your cart.

The post has rotted off at ground level – and the whole section leans

It's always down at the ground that it fails. The post above is intact, but the bottom ten centimeters are soft, and now the whole fence section is pulling crooked. The alternative you've been told is to excavate the post and set a new one in concrete — a whole weekend, and you'd need to borrow an earth auger.

Drive the bracket in next to the post and screw it on

The spike is driven into the ground next to the old post, the bracket is screwed onto the sound part and takes over the load. The post stays where it is, the fence is straightened up, and you don't have to excavate, pour concrete or wait for it to harden.

Features

  • Two brackets for one price – 2-pack, 80 cm per bracket: 40 cm into the ground and 40 cm up along the post
  • You don't have to pull the post out of the ground – the spike is driven in next to the one already there
  • The fence is stable the same day – no concrete that has to cure before you can let go of it
  • Everything you need is in the package – 8 screws, 6 bolts, 6 nuts, adjustable wrench and hex key
  • Rust-protected to stand outside all year – painted steel, not untreated sheet metal

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
